ApiToken.description: An API token as listed (never includes the secret).

created_via.description: `web` (minted on the Tokens page) or `device` (CLI login).

AuthInfo.description: How the web app signs in.

mode.description:
`oidc` (sign in through a provider at `/auth/login`) or `dev`
(every request is a fixed local user).

AuthProvider.description: A sign-in provider the web app can offer.

Comment.description: A comment thread: the top-level comment and its replies.

oneOf.description: Absent for a general comment about the whole parcel.

version.description: The version the commenter was looking at.

CommentAnchor.description: Where on the page a comment points, as recorded by the viewer.

path.description: Published path of the page the comment was made on (`index.html`).

selector.description: CSS selector of the element that was clicked.

text.description:
The element's visible text when the comment was made, used to find
it again after the page changes.

x.description: Click position inside the element's box, as a fraction of its width (0–1).

y.description: Click position inside the element's box, as a fraction of its height (0–1).

CommentAuthor.description: Who wrote a comment, from the caller's point of view.

name.description: Display name (the account's name, else its email).

open.description: Unresolved threads on the parcel, whatever the filter.

CommentReply.description: A reply in a comment thread.

expires_in_days.description: Days until expiry; omit for a token that never expires.

CreatedToken.description: A freshly minted token. `secret` is shown exactly once.

DataCollection.description: A collection as listed in a [`DataSummary`].

usage_bytes.description: What the collection counts against the parcel's data limit.

size_bytes.description: Size of the value as compact JSON.

DataItemList.description: A page of a collection's items, ordered by key.

next_after.description: Pass as `after` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

revision.description: Changes whenever any item is written or deleted.

usage_bytes.description: Each item's JSON size plus a fixed per-item overhead.

writable.description: Whether the caller may change this parcel's data.

client_name.description: Shown on the approval page, e.g. `parcel CLI on laptop`.

device_code.description: Secret the CLI polls with. Never shown to the user.

user_code.description: Short code the user confirms in the browser, e.g. `BCDF-GHJK`.

ErrorBody.description:
The error envelope every non-2xx JSON response uses
(`stridelabs_http::AppError`'s wire contract).

type.description: The HTTP status reason phrase, e.g. `Bad Request`.

page_title.description:
A page's (`.html`, `.htm`, `.md`, `.markdown`) `<title>` or first
`# heading`, read when it was published. Absent for other files, for
a page without one, and for pages published before titles were kept.
Plain text: show it as text, never as markup.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes.

Limits.description: Storage and size limits enforced on publishes.

max_data_bytes.description: Data a parcel may keep (each item's JSON plus a per-item overhead).

max_data_value_bytes.description: Largest single data value, as compact JSON.

user_quota_bytes.description: Total bytes across all of a user's versions; 0 means unlimited.

ListMatch.description: Where a full-text query matched the parcel's page text.

segments.description: The snippet, in order; concatenated they read as a passage of the page.

MatchSegment.description:
One run of a search snippet: text, and whether it is a matched word.
Render it as text (never as HTML): it is the parcel's own content.

handle.description: The user's handle: the `@<handle>` in their parcels' clean URLs.

signed_in_with.description:
Label of the provider this web session signed in with (absent for
API tokens and dev mode).

NewComment.description: `POST /api/v1/parcels/{id}/comments` — a new thread, or a reply.

oneOf.description: Where on the page. Not allowed on replies.

reply_to.description: Reply to this thread instead of starting a new one.

version.description:
The version being commented on. Defaults to the current one; ignored
for replies, which take their thread's.

file.description: One part per file; each part's filename is its published path.

PageEntry.description: One page of a version: a file the viewer can open (HTML or Markdown).

title.description:
The page's title (plain text), or null when it has none on record
(show the path instead).

ParcelAccess.description: What the caller may do with a parcel.

ParcelActivity.description:
`GET /api/v1/parcels/{id}/activity` — what the viewer polls to notice
new versions and comment changes without refetching everything.

comments_revision.description: Changes whenever any comment is added, edited, resolved or deleted.

ParcelDetail.description: A parcel with its history and current files.

is_owner.description: Whether the caller owns this parcel (and so may change it).

owner_name.description: The owner's display name, for signed-in callers.

pages.description: Pages of the current version: the entry first, then the others by path.

total.description: Total number of matching parcels (for pagination).

oneOf.description: Set when `q` matched the parcel's page text.
Set when the caller isn't the owner (someone shared it with them).

ParcelListItem.description:
A parcel in `GET /api/v1/parcels`: the summary's fields, plus what the
list knows about this caller and query.

ParcelSummary.description: A parcel as it appears in lists.

archived_at.description:
When the owner archived it. Archived parcels stay viewable by URL but
are left out of lists, tag counts and search unless asked for.

canonical_url.description:
The URL to show and share: `https://…/@<handle>/<slug>` when the
parcel has a slug, else the same as `url`.

entry.description: Path of the current version's entry page.

owner_handle.description:
The owner's handle. Left out for anonymous callers of a parcel
without a slug (they aren't told who published it).

slug.description:
The parcel's name under its owner's handle (`parcel/plan-001`), if
the owner gave it one.

tags.description: Sorted by bytes. Everyone who can view the parcel sees them.

url.description:
The viewer URL in the web app (`https://…/p/<id>`). Stays this
shape for good (clients append `/v/<n>` to it); show and share
`canonical_url`.

PublishResult.description: Returned by both create and new-version publishes.

created.description:
Whether this publish created the parcel (a create with a `slug` the
caller already uses adds a version instead).

file.description: One part per file; each part's filename is its published path.

to.description: May be a tag already in use: the two merge.

allow_public.description:
Whether parcels may be made public; when false, `internal` is the
widest visibility.

features.description:
Optional API features this server has (`tags`, `search`, `archive`,
…), so a newer client can refuse a parameter an older server would
silently ignore.

Share.description: One person a parcel is shared with.

name.description: Their display name, once someone with this email has signed in.

ShareRole.description: What a person a parcel is shared with may do.

SharedInfo.description: How a parcel in a list came to be shared with the caller.

SharedParcel.description: A parcel someone shared with the caller by name.

SourceInfo.description: A version's provenance. Every field is optional.

repo.description: The repository's remote as `host[:port]/path` (no credentials, no `.git`).

TagCount.description: One tag and how many of the listed parcels carry it.

tags.description: Most used first, then by name.

total.description: How many distinct tags match (for paging).

TagsUpdated.description: How many of the caller's parcels a tag rename or delete changed.

resolved.description: Resolve or reopen a thread (the parcel's owner or the thread's author).

handle.description:
A new handle. The old one keeps resolving to you (and no one else
can take it), so links with it keep working.

UpdateParcelRequest.description: `PATCH /api/v1/parcels/{id}` — metadata only; files change through versions.

slug.description:
Give the parcel this slug (`""` clears it). The old one keeps
redirecting here until another of your parcels takes it.

tags.description: Replace the tag set (`[]` clears it). Not with `add_tags`/`remove_tags`.

Usage.description: What a user is currently storing.

stored_bytes.description: Sum of every version's `total_bytes` (what the quota counts).

pages.description: The version's pages: the entry first, then the others by path.

VersionDetail.description: A version with its file list.

VersionSummary.description: One immutable version of a parcel.

label.description: Optional short note recorded with the publish ("Draft to legal").

oneOf.description: Where it was published from. The owner's only: absent for everyone else.

content_url.description: Signed, expiring URL on the sandboxed content origin.

owner_name.description: The owner's display name, for signed-in callers.

bearer.description: A `pcl_` API token. (The web app sends its session cookie instead.)

info.description: Publish HTML pages (with optional supporting files) to private, sandboxed URLs, manage their versions, visibility and sharing, and read them back. Authenticate with a `pcl_` API token (the CLI and agents); the web app uses the session cookie its server-side sign-in (`/auth/login`) sets. Health probes, sign-in, the sandboxed content origin (`/v/{token}/…`) and the web app itself are deliberately not part of this document.
info.title: Parcel API

post.description: Start a CLI login. Show `user_code` to the user and send them to `verification_uri_complete`, then poll `/cli/device/token`.
Poll a CLI login. Returns `pending` (or `slow_down`) until the user decides; `approved` carries the new API token exactly once.

get.description: Describe a pending CLI login for the approval page.

parameters.description: The code shown in the terminal
parameters.name: user_code

post.description: Approve a pending CLI login as the signed-in user.

parameters.description: The code shown in the terminal

get.description: Unauthenticated description of this server: origins, the sign-in providers the web app offers, whether public links are allowed, limits, and allowed file extensions.
The signed-in user, what they are storing, and the limits that apply.

patch.description: Change the signed-in user's handle (the `@<handle>` in their parcels' clean URLs). The old handle stays theirs and keeps resolving, so existing links keep working; taking one of your own old handles back makes it current again.

get.description: List parcels: the caller's own by default, or those shared with them (`scope=shared`), or both (`scope=all`); most recently updated first, or by relevance with `q`. Filter by tags (`tag=a&tag=b`: all of them) and archive state. Items shared with the caller carry `shared`.

parameters.description:
Search: a case-insensitive substring of the id, title, description or slug,
or full text (title, description, tags and the entry page's text;
web-search syntax: `"exact phrase"`, `-word`, `or`). Results are then
ordered by relevance, and carry `match` when the page text matched.
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Only parcels carrying this tag; repeat for several (all must match).
parameters.name: tag

schema.description: How a list treats archived parcels.

post.description: Create a parcel from a multipart upload. Send an optional `metadata` part (JSON, `CreateParcelMetadata`) and one `file` part per file whose filename is the published path (e.g. `index.html`, `assets/app.js`). With a `slug` the caller already uses (or used, before a rename), this publishes a new version of that parcel instead and answers 200 with `created: false`.

200.description: A new version of the parcel with this slug

409.description: `base_version` is no longer current, or no parcel has the slug yet

413.description: A size, count or quota limit was exceeded

get.description: Resolve a clean URL (`/@<handle>/<slug>`) to the parcel it names: through the handle (or one its user had before), the slug (or one the parcel had before), then the same access rule as `GET /parcels/{id}`. `parcel.canonical_url` is the current clean URL, which differs from the one asked for after a rename. Every miss is the same 404, whatever was missing.

parameters.description:
The owner's handle, or one they had before. Defaults to the caller's
own; required when signed out.
parameters.name: handle

parameters.description: The parcel's slug, or one it had before.
parameters.name: slug

400.description: No `slug`, or no `handle` while signed out

delete.description: Delete a parcel and all its versions. Its URL stops working immediately.

get.description: A parcel with its version history and current files. Public parcels are readable without credentials, internal ones by anyone signed in, private ones by their owner and the people it is shared with.

patch.description: Change a parcel's title, description or visibility (which counts as an update), or organize it: `tags` replaces the tag set, `add_tags`/`remove_tags` edit it, `archived` archives or unarchives, `slug` names it (`""` clears; the old slug keeps redirecting until another of your parcels takes it). Organizing doesn't change `updated_at`. Files change only through new versions.

409.description: Another of your parcels has this slug

get.description: The parcel's current version and comment counters: a cheap poll for noticing new versions and comment changes. Readable wherever the parcel is.
A parcel's comment threads with their replies, oldest first. Visible to the owner, and to any signed-in user when the parcel is public.

post.description: Start a thread (optionally pinned to a spot on the page with `anchor`) or reply to one with `reply_to`. Returns the whole thread.

413.description: The parcel has too many comments

delete.description: Delete a comment (its author or the parcel's owner). Deleting a thread's first comment deletes its replies too.

patch.description: Edit a comment's text (its author) or resolve/reopen a thread (the owner or the thread's author). Returns the whole thread.

get.description: The parcel's data collections and how much of its data limit they use. Readable wherever the parcel is; `writable` says whether the caller may change it.

delete.description: Delete every item in a collection (the owner only).

get.description: A page of a collection's items, by key.

parameters.description: Return keys after this one (the previous page's `next_after`).
parameters.name: after

patch.description: Merge a JSON object into an item (RFC 7386 merge patch: `null` removes a field), creating it if it doesn't exist.

413.description: The value or the parcel's data is over its limit

put.description: Create or replace an item. The body is the value: any JSON.

413.description: The value or the parcel's data is over its limit

get.description: The people a parcel is shared with, by email. Owner only.

delete.description: Stop sharing with someone. Pages they have open stop loading at once. Owner only.

put.description: Share a parcel with someone by email, or change their role. They get access the next time they open it signed in with that (verified) email, including on their first sign-in. Owner only.

get.description: Every version of a parcel, newest first.

post.description: Publish a new version (the URL stays the same). In `merge` mode (default) uploaded files are added or replaced, others are kept, and `remove` drops paths; in `replace` mode the version is exactly the uploaded files. `base_version` makes the publish fail with 409 if someone else published first.

get.description: One version and its files. `version` is a number or `latest`.
Raw bytes of one file, as an attachment. This is how the CLI and agents read a parcel's source; browsers view parcels through the sandboxed content origin instead.

post.description: Publish a new version whose files are a copy of an earlier one.

get.description: A short-lived signed URL on the sandboxed content origin for one page of a version (its entry unless `path` names another of its `pages`) — what the viewer iframe loads. The URL's capability covers the whole version, so the page's relative links to its other files and pages work.

parameters.description: Page to open (one of the version's `pages`; default: its entry).
parameters.name: path

404.description: No such parcel or version, or `path` is not a page of that version

get.description: Parcels other people shared with the caller by email, most recently updated first. (Internal parcels anyone signed in can open aren't listed.)

The tags on the parcels the filters select, each with how many of those parcels carry it (facet counts): most used first, then by name. Takes the same `scope`, `tag`, `q` and `archived` filters as `GET /parcels`.

parameters.description: Count only parcels carrying this tag; repeat for several (all must match).
parameters.name: tag

parameters.description: Count only parcels matching this search (as `GET /parcels`).
parameters.name: q

schema.description: How a list treats archived parcels.

parameters.description: Only tags starting with this, e.g. `project:`.
parameters.name: prefix

post.description: Remove a tag from every parcel the caller owns (a tag can hold `/`, so it goes in the body). Doesn't change any parcel's `updated_at`.
Rename a tag on every parcel the caller owns. Renaming into a tag that is already in use merges the two. Doesn't change any parcel's `updated_at`.

get.description: The caller's active API tokens (secrets are never returned).
